ms.promise:
1. Build the main modules for data collection and processing
2. Impact Dashboard: Create a user interface for visualizing traceability and transparency data.
3. Blockchain-Backed Features: Immutable records stored on the blockchain for critical activities
ms.criteria:
1. Build the main modules:
A functional version capable of collecting data, managing agricultural data, and tracking traceability processes.
2. User Interface and Dashboards:
Data visualization through a dashboard, highlighting critical blockchain-verified information.
3. Blockchain-Backed Features:
Validation of blockchain transactions ensures that the recorded data is accessible, immutable, and accurate.
ms.report:
Hello,
Thank you for your feedback. We’ve created a new presentation video based on your comments, this time starting from data collection all the way to the user interface.
The video is divided into three parts:
I. Data Collection – II. Cardano API Blockchain – III. User Interface / Plot Tracking.
We’ve also updated the hashing process by modifying the token name representing the plot, now including the number of trees planted and the name of the plot.
Enjoy the video:
https://www.loom.com/share/4467c63411494f099768be3b93445d8d?sid=e9ec92e9-edf1-4b93-87ad-103d78666764

ms.promise:

ms.criteria:
1. The tool is fully deployed on the Cardano mainnet with no know bugs.
2. Audit security Scope: 
・All identified vulnerabilities are addressed and resolved
・Successful test transactions from input creation to final retrieval 
・Integration complies with Cardano’s blockchain standards and best practices

3. Communication materials, including case studies, social media content 
4. Final closeout report is publicly available and final closeout video is publicly available
5. Create a written guide (print and digital) easy to navigate, with clear headings, illustrations, and examples.
